description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Faropoint is a real estate investment firm that builds and operates industrial properties. The Software Engineer will build, test, and maintain software for its investment and data platforms, including AI agents and integrations, while improving system reliability and working with internal users.
Software Engineer building production data and investment platforms, integrating machine learning, and extending AI agents and developer tools

Responsibilities:
• Build, test, and maintain production software that powers Faropoint’s data and investment platforms (TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL on AWS)
• Strengthen the reliability and quality of existing systems through rigorous testing, debugging, and continuous improvement: migrations, bug fixes, and tech debt
• Take on scoped technical projects: dig into the problem, propose an approach and its trade-offs, then carry it out
• Help improve test automation, CI/CD, and developer tools such as automated AI code review
• Extend our agents, MCP tools, and Slack apps so people can act without leaving the tools they use
• Wire our machine learning models and data platform into the products that rely on them
• Make effective use of AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code every day, while taking full ownership of the correctness of everything you ship
• Review what agents produce for correctness, security, and fit with our existing patterns before it merges
• Write the tests, plans, and docs that let the next engineer, or agent, pick up where you left off
• Partner closely with engineering, data science, and business stakeholders to turn loosely defined problems into working solutions
• Talk with users across the firm to understand their workflows, ship something small, and improve it based on feedback
• Pick up the business context as you go. No real estate background needed

Requirements:
• 1 to 3 years of experience building and shipping production software
• A degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related discipline
• Strong programming skills and solid computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and how a software project is organized
• Working proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python, and comfort with SQL and relational databases
• Comfort collaborating in Git: branches, pull requests, code review, and resolving merge conflicts
• Daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar), and the judgment to verify their output
• The ability to explain code you didn't write, including an agent's, and talk through design trade-offs
• A demonstrated ability to learn quickly and carry projects through from start to finish. You test your own work and ask for help when you're stuck
• A curious, self-driven mindset, and the communication skills to explain technical work to non-technical stakeholders

Preferred:
• Experience building and testing a full-stack web app (React, Node.js, PostgreSQL; Jest, pytest, or Playwright)
• Experience with database migrations or schema changes on a live system
• Exposure to AWS (Lambda, containers, S3) or CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions
• Experience building with LLMs, agents, MCP servers, or Slack apps
• Familiarity with financial models, spreadsheets, or an interest in finance, real estate, or investing
